meta.name: javascript-sdk
meta.description: JavaScript/TypeScript SDK for inference.sh - run AI apps, build agents, integrate with all models. Package: @inferencesh/sdk (npm install). Full TypeScript support, streaming, file uploads. Build agents with template or ad-hoc patterns, tool builder API, skills, human approval. Use for: JavaScript integration, TypeScript, Node.js, React, Next.js, frontend apps. Triggers: javascript sdk, typescript sdk, npm install, node.js api, js client, react ai, next.js ai, frontend sdk, @inferencesh/sdk, typescript agent, browser sdk, js integration

copy.tagline: 在 JavaScript/TypeScript 项目中集成 AI 推理与智能体构建
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你用 JS/TS 开发并需要调用 AI 模型或构建智能体。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate AI inference and build agents in JavaScript/TypeScript projects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you develop in JS/TS and need to call AI models or build agents.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你用 JavaScript/TypeScript 调用 inference.sh 平台上的 AI 应用和模型，包括运行任务、上传文件、构建带工具和技能的智能体，并支持流式输出和会话管理。
howto.when: 当你提到“JavaScript SDK”、“TypeScript SDK”、“npm install”等关键词，或要求用 Node.js、React、Next.js 等前端框架集成 AI 时触发。

say.text: 用 JavaScript SDK 运行一个图像生成应用，提示词是“日落”。
say.note: Claude 会生成调用代码并解释如何执行。

say.text: 帮我创建一个带计算器和图像生成工具的智能体。
如何在 Next.js 中安全地使用这个 SDK？
say.note: Claude 会介绍服务器代理设置方法。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you use the JavaScript/TypeScript SDK to run AI apps and models on inference.sh, including executing tasks, uploading files, building agents with tools and skills, and supporting streaming and sessions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "JavaScript SDK", "TypeScript SDK", "npm install", or ask to integrate AI with Node.js, React, Next.js, etc.

say_en.text: Run an image generation app with prompt 'sunset' using the JS SDK.
say_en.note: Claude will generate code and explain execution.

say_en.text: Create an agent with a calculator and image generation tool.
say_en.note: Claude will demonstrate Agent SDK and Tool Builder API.

say_en.text: How to use this SDK securely in Next.js?
say_en.note: Claude will explain server proxy setup.
